newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Seven die in attacks in northwest Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Seven die in attacks in northwest Colombia.

text.p: Seven people, including leftist rebels, police and civilians, died on Thursday in the latest violence to sweep a trouble-torn province of northwest Colombia.
Two National Liberation Army (ELN) guerrillas and two policemen died in a firefight following a failed bank raid by rebels in the town of Granada, in Antioquia, police sources said.

A town councillor and two local government officials were shot and the vehicle in which they were travelling was set ablaze in a separate incident in Caucasia, in the northeast of the province. Police blamed ELN rebels for the attack.
